highlight.title: Signora Volpe — Season 3
highlight.badge: Acorn TV Original · Season 3 · Premieres October 5
highlight.description: Emilia Fox returns as former MI6 officer Sylvia Fox for three new feature-length mysteries in the Umbrian countryside, with new episodes weekly through the end of October.

new_arrivals.title: This Is Not a Murder Mystery
new_arrivals.description: A young Salvador Dalí and René Magritte are among the Surrealist artists reunited at a lavish English country estate in the 1930s, only to find themselves trapped there with a serial killer on the loose. A playful art-world spin on the country-house mystery, with new episodes on Mondays.

new_arrivals.title: The Red King
new_arrivals.description: Anjli Mohindra stars as DS Grace Narayan, posted to a remote Welsh island where a missing boy's case leads to a pagan cult the locals insist no longer exists. A police procedural with a folk-horror chill, streaming weekly.

new_arrivals.title: Wolf
new_arrivals.badge: New to Acorn TV · All Episodes
new_arrivals.description: Ukweli Roach plays DI Jack Caffery in this adaptation of Mo Hayder's novels, as a wealthy family is terrorised in their isolated Monmouthshire home. All six episodes arrive at once.

new_arrivals.title: Blue Murder Motel
new_arrivals.badge: Acorn TV Original · Finale in October
new_arrivals.description: Retired detectives Vinny and Cole, now running a New Zealand coastal motel, keep getting pulled back into investigative work as fresh murder cases turn up in their new community.

originals.title: The Chelsea Detective
originals.description: Adrian Scarborough stars as a rumpled, sharp-eyed detective solving murders in one of London's wealthiest neighborhoods — a genuine Acorn TV Original with real bite beneath its polished setting.

originals.title: Signora Volpe
originals.description: Emilia Fox stars as a disillusioned former MI6 operative who settles into a quiet new life in the Umbrian countryside, only to keep stumbling into local mysteries — an Acorn TV Original produced by Route 24.

originals.title: Art Detectives
originals.description: DI Mick Palmer (Stephen Moyer) and DC Shazia Malik solve murders connected to the world of art and antiques, from Old Master paintings to Banksy street art.

originals.title: Dalgliesh
originals.description: Bertie Carvel stars as P.D. James's enigmatic poet-detective in this atmospheric Acorn TV Original, based on the bestselling Adam Dalgliesh mystery novels.
